text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-p-i-e-d l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s f-r-o-m a b-a-c-k-u-p f-o-l-d-e-r a-n-d l-e-f-t e-d-i-t-e-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t s t a-t-i-n-g a t h-e r-e-w-a-s n-o v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f t-h-e o-r-i-g-i-n a-l a-u-t-h-o-r i-t-y.
2) t-h-e p-e-r-s-o-n a-d-d-e-d a p-h-o-t-o f-r-o-m t-h-e o-p-e-n b-l-o-g s-p-o-t t-o t-h-e d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c m-a-t-c-h-i-n-g c-h-e-c-k, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a l-o-g e-n-t-r-y w-i-t-h-o-u-t a n-e-d-g-e d-e-t-a-i-l-s.
3) t-h-e y-e-t-h-e-r c-l-o-n-e-d t-h-e r-f-i-d c-a-r-d a-n-d l-o-c-k-e-d i-t i-n t-h-e s-t-a-f-f-l-o-c-k-e-r d-u-r-i-n-g t-h-e e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a s-c-a-n r-e-c-o-r-d w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l p-o-s-s-e-s-s-i-o-n r-e-v-e-r-s-a-l s-t-e-p.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d t-h-e s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y l-o-g-s t-o r-e-m-o-v-e t-h-e i-n-v-a-l-i-d e-n-t-r-y a-n-d l-e-f-t a t-e-m-p o-r-i-g-i-n a-l f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-a-g-e-r a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n.
5) t-h-e g-r-o-u-p d-e-l-e-t-e-d t-h-e w-o-r-k-i-n-g d-r-a-f-t f-r-o-m t-h-e s-h-a-r-e-d d-r-i-v-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e f-i-n-a-l c-l-e-a-n-u-p v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a m-e-t-a d-a-t-a r-e-m-a-i-n-d-e-r i-n t-h-e t-r-a-s-h f-o-l-d-e-r.
